purpose: Stable lifecycle classification for branch names. Live HEADs/ancestry come only from Git; semantic work status comes only from migration-queue.json.

families.description: Clean shipping family. Keep main as an actual ancestor of the active DirectMetal integration line.
families.exit_condition: never retire while named as canonical roles in manifest.json

families.description: Disconnected legacy history anchors. They locate provenance; they are not clean-tree merge bases.
families.exit_condition: retire only after every referenced migration item is resolved and policy is changed explicitly

families.description: Short-lived review refs for repository control-plane changes.
families.exit_condition: merged/closed PR and no automation or active review depends on the ref

families.description: Minecraft execution/evidence refs. Product ownership is elsewhere.
families.exit_condition: durable oracle and exact-subject provenance are represented outside the branch

families.description: High-value DirectVulkan investigation/replay/artifact refs in the disconnected legacy universe.
families.exit_condition: all migration-queue items citing the ref are resolved/rejected with durable evidence

families.description: One-hypothesis DirectVulkan experiments. Passing experiments never become architecture by inertia.
families.exit_condition: result is distilled into a reusable oracle/contract or explicitly rejected

families.description: Clean-tree correctness/runtime candidates. Unresolved semantics are named in migration-queue.json.
families.exit_condition: PR/tree containment is proven or the semantic candidate lands with exact-head proof

families.description: Minecraft 26.2 DirectMetal runtime closure already merged into integration/directmetal-next.
families.exit_condition: safe retirement additionally requires no open PR/workflow/external dependency and explicit deletion authorization

families.description: Legacy reconciliation/fix refs. Port semantics/oracles only; do not merge the historical architecture wholesale.
families.exit_condition: cited migration debts are resolved and unique provenance is durable

families.description: Eleven phased DirectMetal performance refs whose PRs were individually merged into integration/directmetal-next. They are historical implementation/proof sources, not parallel active product ownership.
families.exit_condition: safe retirement additionally requires no open PR/workflow/external dependency and explicit deletion authorization

families.description: Tooling source refs whose reusable behavior should live in the clean control plane.
families.exit_condition: clean-tree equivalent exists and no open PR/automation references the branch

families.description: Validation/evidence subjects; never infer product ownership from these branch names.
families.exit_condition: exact-subject evidence/provenance is durable outside the branch
